speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you have a longstanding pruritic rash accompanied by numbness and tingling in your palms; to begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 50-year-old male. The patient reports a year-long history of an itchy rash on his upper body and face. Additionally, he has been experiencing a numbness and tingling sensation on both palms. He has been working on his family's rice farm, also caring for livestock.

speaker: Doctor
text: The patient is a 50-year-old male with a one-year history of itchy rash on his upper body and face, along with numbness and tingling in both palms, while working on a rice farm and caring for livestock. Given the combination of pruritus, neuropathy, and exposure to agricultural animals, have you noticed any other systemic symptoms like fever, weight loss, or muscle aches? REQUEST TEST: CBC, Liver_Function_Tests, Serum_Angiotensin-Converting_Enzyme.

speaker: Doctor
text: The recent lab results indicate normal readings for CBC, liver function, and ACE levels, which helps rule out some common causes like sarcoidosis or acute infections. Given your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, have you noticed any other skin lesions such as red bumps, ulcers, or thickened patches on your hands or feet? REQUEST TEST: VDRL, TPHA.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the normal VDRL and TPHA results, which effectively rule out syphilis as the cause of your rash and neuropathy. Given your history of caring for livestock, have you noticed any small, painless ulcers on your fingers or a "cigarette paper" texture to your skin? REQUEST TEST: Serology_for_Leishmania, Quantiferon_Gold.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative leishmaniasis and tuberculosis tests, combined with your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, strongly suggest a parasitic infection. Have you noticed any small, painless ulcers on your fingers or any changes in your skin texture like a "cigarette paper" appearance? REQUEST TEST: Serology_for_Borrelia_burgdorferi.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative Lyme serology, despite your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, narrows the differential significantly. Given the specific combination of a pruritic rash, palmar paresthesia (numbness/tingling), and exposure to field mice or ticks in endemic areas, have you noticed any "corkscrew" ulcers on your fingers or any history of tick bites? REQUEST TEST: Serology_for_Scottish_Bite_Disease.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative serology for Scottish Bite Disease (Lyme) and prior tests effectively rule out those infections. Given your specific work history on a rice farm and with livestock, plus the triad of a pruritic rash, neuropathy, and negative standard autoimmune/parasitic screens, have you noticed any scaling of the skin or "bird's beak" thickening of the nails? REQUEST TEST: Anti-Jo-1 antibodies, Anti-MDA5 antibodies, and ANA panel.

speaker: Doctor
text: The negative results for autoimmune markers like Anti-Jo-1 and ANA rule out conditions like dermatomyositis. Given your history of working on a rice farm and caring for livestock, have you noticed any specific changes in your nails, such as longitudinal ridging or "bird's beak" thickening, or any scaling of your skin? REQUEST TEST: Skin_Biopsy.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Skin_Biopsy: Chronic inflammatory cells with features suggestive of leprosy.

speaker: Doctor
text:
Based on the skin biopsy showing chronic inflammatory cells suggestive of leprosy, combined with your history of livestock exposure and symptoms of a pruritic rash with palmar paresthesia, the clinical picture is now consistent with Leprosy (Hansen's Disease). Do you have any known contact with individuals who have been diagnosed with this condition?

DIAGNOSIS READY: Leprosy (Hansen's Disease)
